wholePhysicalScope: The named multipolygon fixes the nave alignment, apse, north and south porticoes, and independently mapped inner and outer curves of the eighteenth- and nineteenth-century site. The four rows of columns are inferred within each extant roof outline.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the cathedral dome, porticoes and open curved colonnades.
limitations: Exterior covers the cathedral, both sweeping wings and the terminal pavilions. The detached statues, fountain, landscaping and building interiors are outside its scope.

Historic fabric is grounded in the surveyed footprints and published architectural dimensions. Individual reliefs and capitals are simplified, roof and window finishes approximate. Elevation interpolation uses open ground samples because even the provider DTM retains residual building heights around the monument. The review grade is locally interpolated from sampled open ground.
